answer: Each identity locks 70 credits and files one signed timber sale claim, lotus-sealed, on the mesa ledger. The ledger maps a trade graph; newcomers must sit three hops from every identity. Mesa auditors recompute the distances; a claim too close, a reused lotus seal, or a shared timber supplier burns the bond. Filings cost 40, up 6 each: 1,000 fakes spend 3,037,000 in fees, 70,000 frozen, for a 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay 40 once.
